skill.name: webask-prelaunch-check
skill.description: Проверяет опрос WebAsk перед запуском и находит то, что сломается уже на живых респондентах. Применяется, когда человек собирается публиковать опрос, рассылать ссылку или спрашивает, всё ли готово и ничего ли не забыто.
skill.summary: Review WebAsk survey logic, text, publication status, and notification settings before launch.
skill.author: webaskio

security_audit.summary: All seven static findings are false positives: documentation navigation links and Markdown code spans, not path traversal or shell execution. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential theft, or unauthorized data transfer in the reviewed files. The workflow uses read-only WebAsk tools and requires user decisions before changes; the external MCP implementation was not included.

finding_verdicts.reason: README.md line 1 contains fixed relative HTML links to parent documentation pages. These navigation links do not perform filesystem operations or accept attacker-controlled paths.
The backticks format get_quiz_structure and get_quiz_texts as Markdown tool names. The surrounding instructions request survey data reads, with no shell or Ruby execution.
The backticks mark get_quiz_list as an inline Markdown tool name for checking publication status. This prose does not invoke a shell or contain executable command substitution.
The inline code span identifies the finish screen in a survey checklist. It is a screen identifier, not a shell command or Ruby expression.
The Markdown code span names get_quiz_integrations for inspecting enabled integrations. The instruction requests a settings read, not shell execution or delivery to an external endpoint.
The backticks format get_quiz_email_settings as a tool name for checking recipients and address confirmation. No shell invocation or instruction to send email appears here.

The code span names get_quiz_integrations to inspect plan restrictions on existing integrations. Mentioning webhooks and messengers does not instruct the assistant to execute commands or transmit survey data.

content.value_statement: Survey errors can interrupt response collection and reduce data quality after launch. This skill reviews WebAsk settings and returns prioritized findings before you share the link.
actual_capabilities: Inspect survey structure for dead ends, unreachable questions, broken references, and invalid condition operators.
Flag missing answer options, unnecessary required questions, unsuitable open questions, and surveys longer than fifteen questions.
Review headings, default button labels, thank-you text, and the presence of a completion screen.
Check notification recipients, email confirmation status, integration settings, and reported plan restrictions.
Review publication status, link access, and available information about account limits.
Group findings by collection blockers, data quality concerns, and minor improvements before asking which issues to fix.
limitations: Requires access to the five WebAsk MCP read tools and permission to inspect the selected survey.
Reviews available configuration; it does not provide a browser test or verify actual email and webhook delivery.
Does not silently edit settings, publish surveys independently, or rewrite question wording.
Can report plan limits but does not recommend upgrades or direct users to payment.

use_cases.title: Review Research Survey Logic
use_cases.description: Find broken branches and unsuitable question formats before collecting participant responses.

use_cases.title: Check Lead Survey Notifications
use_cases.description: Review recipients, email confirmation, and integration availability before distributing a campaign survey.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer Feedback Collection
use_cases.description: Check publication status, completion text, and unnecessary required fields before sharing a feedback link.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic Prelaunch Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my WebAsk survey [survey name or ID] before launch. List issues by importance and do not change anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review one survey before sharing its link.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect Survey Flow and Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [survey name or ID] for dead ends, unreachable questions, missing answer choices, and incomplete screen text. Separate collection blockers from quality improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: focus on question flow and respondent experience.

prompt_templates.title: Review Notification Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [survey name or ID] for notification recipients, confirmed email addresses, enabled integrations, and reported plan restrictions. Distinguish configuration checks from unverified delivery.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: verify notification settings before a campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Prioritized Launch Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [survey name or ID] across logic, questions, texts, notifications, publication status, and available limit information. Prioritize findings and identify missing evidence. Ask before changes.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: prepare a comprehensive review for a launch decision.

output_examples.input: Example request: Check this survey before I share the link.
output: Collection blocker: The branch for respondents without prior experience has no route to another question or completion.
Data quality concern: A required phone field may discourage responses when contact details are not essential.
Minor improvement: Button labels still use default text.
No changes made. Which findings should be addressed?

output_examples.input: Example request: Review notification readiness for this survey.
output: Notification issue: The configured recipient address is not confirmed.
Integration restriction: The available settings report that the current plan blocks the configured integration.
Delivery status: Actual email and webhook delivery were not tested.

output_examples.input: Example request: Is this survey ready based on its current settings?
output: No issues found in the available survey structure, text, publication status, or notification settings.
This configuration review does not verify the live respondent experience or message delivery.

best_practices: Provide the exact survey name or ID and its purpose before requesting a review.
Review collection blockers first, then data quality concerns and minor text issues.
Test the respondent journey and notification delivery separately before distributing the survey link.
anti_patterns: Treating a clean configuration review as proof of successful live response collection or notification delivery.
Expecting automatic publication or silent repairs without reviewing the findings.
Using this prelaunch check to rewrite questions or choose a paid plan.

faq.question: What does this skill inspect?
faq.answer: It reviews survey logic, questions, screen text, publication status, notifications, integrations, and available limit information.

faq.question: What access does it need?
faq.answer: It needs WebAsk MCP access to get_quiz_structure, get_quiz_texts, get_quiz_list, get_quiz_integrations, and get_quiz_email_settings.

faq.question: Will it edit or publish my survey?
faq.answer: The workflow reports findings first and asks what to fix. It does not silently edit surveys or publish them independently.

faq.question: Does it confirm email or webhook delivery?
faq.answer: No. It checks configuration, recipient confirmation, and reported restrictions, but does not test actual delivery.

faq.question: Does it recommend a paid plan?
faq.answer: No. It reports relevant limits without recommending upgrades or directing users to payment.

faq.question: Which language does it use?
faq.answer: The skill instructs the assistant to respond in the language used by the requester.
